page_title: WER 0-3 LEV | Werder Bremen v Bayer Leverkusen 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+2' A pass lands at the feet of Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Granit Xhaka is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen).
89' A substitution has been made. Jonas Hofmann is replaced by Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen).
88' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Michael Zetterer easily deals with the threat.
86' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) tries to find Justin Njinmah, but he puts too much power on the pass.
85' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
83' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) replaces Romano Schmid.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Jung cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
81' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Jeremie Frimpong is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' Here comes a substitution. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Wirtz.
80' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
76' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
76' 0 - 3 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 0:3.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) will replace Leonardo Bittencourt.
72' Substitution. Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) on for Rafael Borre.
71' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Victor Boniface.
70' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
66' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
63' The Werder Bremen players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Martin Petersen signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
62' Wait! Referee Martin Petersen immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
62' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
60' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. Martin Petersen had a clear view and blows his whistle.
59' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

59' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
56' It will be a substitution. Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Olivier Deman walks off.
55' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
54' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
53' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) makes a strong challenge and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
49' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.

49' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
46' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 2 Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared to safety by the defence.

42' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
36' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card!
36' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
35' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) trips an opposition player and Martin Petersen signals a foul. Free kick. Werder Bremen will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' A rebound sits up perfectly for Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
31' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Martin Petersen saw the whole situation.
29' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a precise pass into the box, but Victor Boniface loses the one-on-one with the defender.
28' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
28' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Werder Bremen.
27' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick, but Michael Zetterer reads it well and stops the effort.
27' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

22' What a poor attempt! Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
20' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is caught offside!
17' A pass into the penalty area from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
14' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee.
12' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

11' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
9' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.
7' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
3' The ball is cleared after Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Martin Petersen will referee today's match.
